_doc: Reviewed acknowledgements for limitation hazard states whose consumer is intentionally null. Each entry signs a (kind, evidence_state) pair that has no executable analytic gate whose verdict changes on that state. Generated review objects copy the matching acknowledgement into unwired_acknowledged; the publication gate refuses required hazards without either a consumer or one of these acknowledgements.
